leakage_findings.availability_scope: Retrospective public release study only; no pre-collection availability asserted.
leakage_findings.feature_cutoff: All context available by 2025-12-23 < observation_time 2025-12-24; no historical aggregates.

limitations: Retrospective supervised association study of the released 2024 PDP cohort only. Digital context and outcomes were released together; pre-assay public availability and operational prospective validation are unproved.

Detection depends on analyte/commodity assay sensitivity and sampling program; ND is not zero residue, absence of all pesticides, safe food or legal compliance. No tolerance comparison or regulatory exceedance target.
One fixed parent analyte (967 Imidacloprid); metabolites and other analytes are excluded. No sample-level any-pesticide label or untested negative manufactured.
One re-extraction excluded under a prespecified conservative original-result policy; NP would be excluded as marginal-performing nondetect. This selection can affect estimand and missingness.
Temporal collection-date holdout measures later-2024 cohort association, not a model trainable during 2024: all labels were published after the cohort. No future-year generalization is established.
No verified lot, farm, supplier or facility grouping; repeated upstream entities may remain. Do not claim new-farm/facility performance or representative population prevalence.
Imbalanced observed target; use prevalence baseline and class-aware metrics. Person B owns fitting, calibration, explanation and evaluation; no model or accuracy claim produced here.
Country null mixes domestic non-applicability and unknown origin. Quantity null is unknown, never zero. Native categorical tokens are not harmonized; variety text remains withheld.
No cross-source or historical features; NOAA ambient weather is not cold-chain telemetry. Pending FSIS, inspections and sensor datasets remain unavailable.
Actual IBM Z LinuxONE/s390x runtime has not been tested. Portable stdlib CSV/JSON path validated locally on x86_64 only.

split_audit.limitation: Released cohort study only; not a prospective 2024 backtest. No label-availability assumption at earlier collection boundaries.

split_recommendation.policy: Whole collection days in chronological order, all rows of each sample together. Dataset has one row per sample. Fit all transforms on training only. Require both classes per partition; stop if unsupported.
split_recommendation.rationale: Later collection-period holdout probes within-2024 drift without analytical sample overlap. All labels released together: this is retrospective temporal validation, not evidence a model could be trained during 2024. No result availability at earlier training boundaries is claimed.
split_recommendation.secondary: GROUPED sample holdout for within-cohort comparison; GEOGRAPHIC only after source location semantics reviewed. No facility IDs; cannot prove lot/farm independence.

target_contract: Publisher original-extraction imidacloprid detection (O=1) versus validated well-recovered nondetect (ND=0). NP marginal-performing nondetect and R re-extraction excluded. Nondetect is assay-relative, not zero residue or safe food.
